advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Make the inbound remove-label / unassign cells non-vacuous by running a local pass to confirm the value is PRESENT locally before removing it in DC (mirror the outbound remove-label cell's mid-assertion).
evidence: `_in_remove_label` docstring: 'a removal cell that never had the label would pass vacuously, so the label is first driven all the way into the index.' — but it is driven into the DC INDEX, not the local store.

In `test_inbound_mutation_round_trips` only one local pass runs (`cp = _run(dc_store_copy_repo, _WRITING_MODE, only=...)` at line 348) AFTER `mutate` completes both add and remove, so the local store never sees the intermediate present-state.

`_oracle_in_remove_label` asserts `expected not in (ticket.get('tags') or [])` (line 228) and `_oracle_in_unassign` asserts `not ticket.get('assignee')` (line 305) — both are satisfied by an always-absent field.

Contrast the OUTBOUND cell `test_outbound_remove_label_round_trips` which runs a SEPARATE pass after the add and asserts `label in labels` (lines 508-514) before removing — the anti-vacuity guard the inbound cells lack.
advisory.finding: Inbound removal cells (_in_remove_label, _in_unassign) can pass vacuously: they add then remove the value entirely on the DC side before the single local reconcile pass, so the local ticket never observes the value present. A bridge that never carried an inbound label/assignee at all would leave the local field already-absent and still satisfy the 'not in tags' / 'not assignee' oracle.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Correct the module docstring's '28 independent verdicts' to the actual implemented cell count (~22) so it matches the commit message and the parametrize lists.
evidence: Docstring: 'The rows are parametrized rather than looped inside one function, so pytest reports 28 independent verdicts.'

`_INBOUND_CELLS` has 8 entries (lines 311-320) and `_OUTBOUND_CELLS` has 6 entries (lines ~314 of outbound table), plus the standalone cells; the commit message states '22 live cells that mutate one observable each'.
Several planned rows (inbound row 1 create, outbound clear-assignee, inbound/outbound clear-parent, delete link) are intentionally not implemented as cells, so 28 is not reached.
advisory.finding: The module docstring claims pytest reports '28 independent verdicts' (14 mutations x 2 directions), but the file defines roughly 22 cells (8 inbound parametrized + 6 outbound parametrized + outbound-remove-label + inbound-link + outbound-link + set_parent-decline + delete-probe + inbound-assignee-identity + pagination + base_url). The commit message itself says '22 live cells', contradicting the docstring.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Give test_dc_mutations.py a module-level `_live_jira_ready` sentinel (or otherwise enroll its cells in the `jira_live` marker) so the all-skip canary counts them.
evidence: tests/external/conftest.py:60-62: `for item in items: if getattr(item.module, "_live_jira_ready", None) is not None: item.add_marker(pytest.mark.jira_live)`
tests/external/conftest.py:94: canary counts only `it.get_closest_marker("jira_live")` items
Sibling modules define the sentinel at module level: test_transport.py:51 `def _live_jira_ready`, test_harness_smoke.py:84, test_reconcile_pass.py:59 — each documenting it as the canary hook
ABSENCE: `search_files(_live_jira_ready, test_dc_mutations.py)` returns no matches; the module imports `skip_no_harness as _skip` from _dc_support instead of exposing a module-level sentinel

If the harness is unreachable or the [jira-datacenter] extra is missing, all 28 cells skip and the scheduled canary (tests/external/conftest.py:99) will not fail for this suite — the exact 'green run validated nothing' failure the sibling modules guard against
advisory.finding: test_dc_mutations.py defines no module-level `_live_jira_ready` sentinel, so its 28 live cells are never marked `jira_live` and are invisible to the all-skip canary that every sibling live_jira_dc module relies on to prevent a silently-all-skipped green run.
scenarios: Scheduled external-integration run where the DC harness fails to become ready and every cell in this new suite skips silently
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a module-level `_live_jira_ready` function to test_dc_mutations.py (re-exporting `_dc_support.live_jira_ready`) as the sibling modules do, so tests/external/conftest.py's collection hook marks its cells `jira_live`.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Extend test_inbound_link_round_trips to remove the Jira link, re-run the pass, and assert the local dep is gone (or drop the removal claim from the docstring).
evidence: Docstring line 538: `"""Rows 10-11 inbound: a Jira issue link surfaces as a local dep, and its removal removes it."""`
Body only mutates once (`dc_transport.set_relationship(key, other, "Blocks")`, line 545) and asserts arrival (`assert other_local in targets`, line 559)
ABSENCE: no `remove`/unlink of the relationship and no assertion that the dep is later absent
advisory.finding: test_inbound_link_round_trips is documented as covering link removal ('and its removal removes it') but the body only asserts the link ARRIVES; there is no removal call and no absence assertion, so inbound link-removal is regression-blind.
scenarios: A bridge that surfaces an inbound link but fails to remove the local dep when the Jira link is deleted

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add the outbound unlink half: after asserting arrival, call rebar.unlink, re-run the pass, and assert the DC issuelink is absent (or correct the docstring).
evidence: Docstring lines 574-576: `Rows 10-11 outbound: a local 'blocks' link surfaces in 'fields.issuelinks', and unlink removes it. Both halves in one cell ... asserted separately below`
Body: `rebar.link(local_id, other_local, "blocks", ...)` (line 598) then asserts `other in seen` (line 608)
ABSENCE: no `rebar.unlink` call and no assertion that the DC issuelink is later absent; `rebar.unlink` exists (resolve_symbol: EXISTS rebar.unlink)
advisory.finding: test_outbound_link_round_trips claims 'and unlink removes it. Both halves in one cell ... asserted separately below', but the body only calls rebar.link and asserts arrival — there is no rebar.unlink and no absence assertion, and nothing is asserted below.
scenarios: A bridge that writes an outbound link but fails to remove it from fields.issuelinks when the local link is dropped

Only test_set_parent_declines_the_epic_case_loudly (line 621) is present, asserting the NotImplementedError path

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Restore a module-level `_live_jira_ready` sentinel (or re-export it) in test_store_copy_isolation.py / test_dc_mutations.py so tests/external/conftest.py:61 still applies the `jira_live` marker after the sentinel was removed.
evidence: Removed signature (diff, test_store_copy_isolation.py): `-def _live_jira_ready() -> bool:`

Diff replaces the module-level sentinel with imports only: `+from _dc_support import skip_no_harness as _skip` (no `_live_jira_ready` bound at module scope; the helper in _dc_support.py is named `live_jira_ready`, without the leading underscore)
Surviving consumer tests/external/conftest.py:61: `if getattr(item.module, "_live_jira_ready", None) is not None:` then `item.add_marker(pytest.mark.jira_live)`

Convention confirmed on sibling live modules that still define it: tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_transport.py:51, test_harness_smoke.py:84, test_reconcile_pass.py:59
advisory.finding: Removing the module-level `_live_jira_ready` sentinel from tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_store_copy_isolation.py (replaced by `from _dc_support import skip_no_harness as _skip`) leaves the surviving auto-marker in tests/external/conftest.py, which keys off `getattr(item.module, '_live_jira_ready', None)`, with no attribute to find — so that module's tests silently lose the `jira_live` marker the canary relies on.
scenarios: A scheduled external-integration run where the auto-marker in conftest.py no longer tags test_store_copy_isolation.py (and the new test_dc_mutations.py) as `jira_live`, so `_jira_canary_should_fail` under-counts collected `jira_live` tests and the all-skip canary can go green while these live tests silently skipped.
advisory.suggested_fix: In _dc_support.py rename/alias `live_jira_ready` to `_live_jira_ready` (or add `_live_jira_ready = live_jira_ready`) and `from _dc_support import _live_jira_ready` in both test_store_copy_isolation.py and test_dc_mutations.py so each module re-exposes a module-level `_live_jira_ready` attribute; alternatively update conftest.py's auto-marker to detect the imported skip markers instead of the `_live_jira_ready` attribute.
